objective: Test whether exact rank-local extraction of current-mover immediate-win opportunity removes the component-parity Q-V counterexamples before any XOR valuation is rejected more broadly.
rationale: Every tested MOD2 component-parity Q-V failure is a two-pair component substitution.
The first complete-4x4 failure is draw versus an immediate current-mover win.
First-win opportunity is an absorbing game-semantic condition, unlike Nim normal-play self-cancellation.
added_coordinate: current mover has at least one immediate winning literal action, derived from reduced q and support before values
anti_circularity: immediate-win flag is computed from current support and owned singleton residuals only
no solved values or future classes define the flag
component types and MOD2 key remain unchanged from EW-RS-012
falsifiers: If MOD2_P_WIN remains Q-V-inconsistent, immediate-win terminal extraction is not sufficient to restore XOR composition.
If it passes Q-V but fails Q-F, retain the result only as scalar-value preprocessing.
A pass does not establish XOR beyond tested bounded domains or beyond this terminal extraction.
